info.title: CompanyOS Core API
info.description: Phase 1.3 — dashboard BFF + workspace + auth + hello.

get.summary: GET /api/v1/dashboard — first-paint widget descriptors for the shell home.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Period window hint (default `30d`). Metrics are not invented from this.

get.summary: GET /api/v1/hello — list hello messages for the caller's org only.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/hello — write hello row + outbox + audit in one transaction.

patch.summary: PATCH /api/v1/sales/deals/{id} — field + stage updates; writes stage history on stage change.

post.description:
**Idempotent**: if the deal is already `won`, returns the current deal
without emitting a second `deal.won.v1` event.

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/sales/imports/customers/confirm — single all-or-nothing
transaction (see module docs for the 10k-row scaling note).

post.description:
One transaction: creates the customer + primary contact + deal, marks the
lead converted, and emits `lead.converted.v1` + `customer.created.v1`.
Duplicate detection runs before conversion — callers must pass
`force: true` to proceed despite matches. Idempotent on `Idempotency-Key`.

get.summary: GET /api/v1/sales/pipelines/default/board — kanban view: stages + open deals.

patch.description:
If the current quote is `accepted`, this creates a **new** draft version
(`version_number + 1`, `previous_quote_id` set to the accepted quote) and
leaves the accepted row untouched. Otherwise the draft is updated in place.

get.description:
Available when the quote is accepted — Finance creates the invoice from a
quote snapshot (no CRM table reads on the finance side).

post.summary: POST /api/v1/finance/invoices/from-quote — snapshot only, no CRM table reads.

patch.summary: PATCH /api/v1/finance/invoices/{id} — draft only; requires If-Match version.

post.summary: POST /api/v1/finance/recurring/run-due — create draft invoices from due templates.
POST decide — Idempotency-Key; duplicate decide is a no-op.
POST /api/v1/people/leave/accrue — post an accrual ledger entry (admin).

post.description:
Straight-line depreciation for whole months elapsed since
`last_depreciated_at` (or `acquired_at` on the first run) through
`as_of_date` (defaults to today). A run with zero elapsed months (e.g. a
same-day retry) is a no-op — no journal is posted and `last_depreciated_at`
is left untouched, which is what makes calling this endpoint repeatedly
safe without a separate Idempotency-Key ledger. Posting the journal and
updating the asset happen in one transaction: a finance rejection (e.g. a
closed fiscal period) rolls back the accumulated-depreciation update too.

Posts each GRN line as a `receipt` stock movement, accumulates the
matching PO line's `qty_received`, recomputes the PO status, and posts a
single Dr Inventory / Cr AP journal to finance-service for the total
received value. All in one transaction: a rejected journal (e.g. a
closed fiscal period) rolls back the stock movements and PO update too.

Records the AP liability for a *posted* goods receipt against
`supplier_ref` (finance-service's own supplier reference — inventory
does not own the AP supplier master). The bill amount is the sum of the
GRN's line values (`qty_received * unit_cost_minor`), i.e. exactly the
value already booked to Inventory/AP via [`finance_client::post_receipt_journal`]
when the GRN was posted.

`{id}` is finance-service's own vendor-bill public id (`vb_…`) — the id
returned by [`create_vendor_bill_from_receipt`]. Dr AP / Cr Cash is
posted entirely on finance's side; inventory-service only forwards the
request and relays the resulting bill state back to its own caller.

post.summary:
POST /api/v1/inventory/purchase-requests/{id}/decide — approval callback
from `companyos-project` (approvals). Requires the same write permission;
the callback authenticates as an actor with organization-scope access
(mirrors `hr-service`'s payroll `/decide` endpoint).

role.description: Public role id or system key.

as_of.description: RFC3339 timestamp when this snapshot was produced.

period.description: Requested period window (e.g. `30d`); accepted but does not invent metrics.

role_layout.description: Derived from the caller's primary role.

payload.description: Widget-specific JSON body (checklist items, empty lists, module stubs).

stale.description: Always false for honest empties in Phase 1.4 (pattern present for later).

role.description: Public role id (`rol_…`) or system key (`owner`, `admin`, …).

challenge_token.description: When Owner/Admin must enroll before an access token exists.

skip_exact_duplicates.description: Skip rows that look like exact-email duplicates of existing customers.

csv.description: Raw CSV text (header row + data rows).

mapping.description: Optional header alias overrides, e.g. `{"Company Name": "company"}`.

checklist.description: Optional checklist override applied before close.

ledger_account_id.description: Ledger account public id (`acc_…`) or code (e.g. `1000`).

customer_id.description: Finance customer public id (`cus_…` projection) or sales customer id.

fx_rate_num.description: FX rate as rational num/den captured at issue (document currency → base).

amount_minor.description: Defaults to the full outstanding balance when omitted.

reverses_of.description: Public id of the journal being reversed (`jrn_…`).

source_id.description:
Internal UUID of the source document (payroll run id).
Empty / omitted for manual → generated UUID.

line_ids.description: Optional: restrict auto-match to these statement line UUIDs / public keys.

ApprovalMode.description: Approval modes for multi-step / multi-approver policies.

customer_id.description: Opaque Sales customer public id (`cus_…`) — stored as UUID, never joined.

PolicyMatch.description: Match criteria evaluated at request time (snapshotted onto the approval).

pending_approvals_for_me.description: Pending approvals assigned to the current user (Phase 1.7).

oneOf.description: Publishing a new definition increments version (immutable history).

government_id.description: Restricted — encrypted at rest; requires write + stored for sensitive read.

submit.description: When true, immediately submit into the approval engine.

fail_after.description: Test hook: inject activity failure after this step for compensation tests.

role.description: Role key to assign via membership update activity (opaque; applied by access step).

user_id.description: Link existing user (`usr_…`); otherwise user_id stays null until linked.

reverses_id.description: Public id of the fact row to reverse (creates append-only reversal).

token.description: Opaque token for gateway SSE proxy (Phase 1.8 stub).

download_url.description:
Download URL. Clients SHOULD set `Content-Disposition: attachment`
when proxying to force download rather than inline render.

unit_cost_minor.description: Defaults to the PO line's `unit_cost_minor` when omitted.

qty_delta.description:
Signed quantity delta. Positive for receipt/return/transfer_in,
negative for issue/transfer_out. `adjustment` may be either sign.

as_of_date.description: ISO date to depreciate through (defaults to today).

cogs_journal_public_id.description:
Present only when this movement was an issue/transfer-out and a COGS
journal was posted to finance-service.
